changelog: Added YouTube-style double-tap seeking in the Android video player: double-tap the right side to jump forward +10s, double-tap the left side to rewind -10s (stacking smoothly on rapid taps with visual HUD pills), and double-tap the center to Play/Pause.
Added full YouTube-style playback speed controls (0.25x, 0.5x, 0.75x, 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 1.75x, 2x) right in the player bar (tap to pick speed, long-press to reset to 1x).

Added a full in-app Download Manager for movies and TV episodes with an in-app Download Options dialog (Wi-Fi only toggle + optional external subtitle download), a dedicated Current Downloads section inside My List with live progress bars, cancel/retry controls, and direct offline playback inside CineVault without opening external browsers.
